text.p: Headlines from major national newspapers. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
EL PAIS
- Basque separatist group ETA ordered assasination or death by starvation of kidnapped prison worker Jose Antonio Ortega Lara. Ortega Lara was rescued by police after 532 days in captivity.
- Five dead and 19 injured in coach crash near Guardarrama.
EL MUNDO
- ETA's logistics chief Julian Atxurra Pototo ordered killing or leaving to die of hunger of Ortega Lara.
DIARIO 16
- Telefonica takes control of Antena 3.
ABC
- New tragedy on roads when coach tumbles off La Coruna motorway.
LA VANGUARDIA
- Telefonica strengthens way by sharing the football rights.
CINCO DIAS
- Wall Street shakes European stock markets.
- Hypermarket sales falls five percent in June compared with May.
- Catalan television channel TV3 holds back on war over football rights.
EXPANSION
- International Monetary Fund Managing Director Michel Camdessus suggests Bundesbank be calm regarding interest rates.
- Telefonica reinforces its alliance with TV3 by putting Carles Vilarrubi on the board of Antena 3 TV.
GACETA DE LOS NEGOCIOS
- Grey Monday during which Madrid bourse lost 2.28 percent.
- Private credit consolidates in July, rising 11 percent.
- Seat asks Volkeswagen to manufacture "Arosa" model in Spain.
